page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. A running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A gathering signature at the foot left.

main_text.p: eum familiæ herciscundæ re-cuperaturum à coheredibus fuisse, quantum ab his creditor actione de peculio conse-qui potuisset. Igitur & si re in integra familiæ herciscundæ agatur, ita peculium dividi æquum esse, ut ad quantitatem eius indemnis à coherede præ-stetur. Porrò eum quem ad-uersus extraneum defendi oportet, longè magis in eo quod fratri debuisset, indemnem esse præstandum.

Facturus interpretationem legis e-ius, quæ (mea sententia) nostris hominibus non sine causa semper obscurissima visa est, præmunienda quædam ar-bitror, quibus quasi gradibus facilius ad eius auditum peruenire possimus. Intelligendum est igitur primum, Eos qui

page.notes: The page number reads "313" but the last digit is doubtful. The running head is decorated and only partly legible; I could not read it reliably. The line "obscurissima" appears split across lines without a printed hyphen, so I wrote it whole; the break may be an error. Possible printing errors: "eiusauditum" is printed without a space and I have read it as "eius auditum"; "fi re in / tegra" is read as "si re in integra" with the word split at the line end. The gathering signature is unclear and may be "x 2" or "x ă".
